requiredBehaviors.behavior: retain stable brain identity across repository rename or move

requiredBehaviors.behavior: update repository location through a federation event after verification

requiredBehaviors.evidence: Failure Handling requires retaining the last known registry entry with unavailable status and freshness metadata.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Stable brainId explicitly prevents duplicate identity on rename.
